profile.headline: Software Engineer at Three Rivers Systems
profile.summary:
- 7+ years of experience developing and maintaining web applications, database, and writing user manuals
- Client-Server based applications developed using Visual Basic, Classic ASP, JavaScript, AJAX, and PHP
- Work with a variety of database systems including MS SQL Server 2000/2005, MySQL, MS Access, and XML and database frameworks including ODBC and ADO
- Strong in backend database development including designing and administering databases, writing stored procedures, and SQL queries
- Good working knowledge with Object Oriented Programming Languages such as C and C++
- Broad knowledge of SDLC, Agile Software Development Methodology such as Extreme Programming Practices
- Excellent analytical, interpersonal, multi-tasking, and problem-solving skills
- Good communication skills, highly motivated, works well in both team environment and individual assignments

positions.title: Senior Web Programmer
positions.description:
- Reviewed, analyzed and modified the web systems including documenting, designing, developing, testing, monitoring, and maintaining as specified by client
- Participated in technical and business discussions, shared ideas, and provided feedback with the goals of continual improvement of the systems
- Worked in several programming languages including MS SQL Server 2005, Classic ASP, HTML, VB Scripts, CSS, and JavaScript as well as combinations of languages such as AJAX.

company.name: ANDRIS COMMUNICATIONS / LYON WORKSPACE PRODUCTS LLC

positions.title: Classic ASP/Database Web Developer
positions.description:
- Communicated effectively with clients to identify needs and evaluate alternative business process solutions
- Responsible for working on multiple projects simultaneously
- Designed, developed, and tested web applications using Classic ASP, JavaScript, HTML, VB Scripts, MS SQL Server 2000/2005, and CSS.
- Understand advanced relational database objects, demonstrated proficiency with physical and logical database design, and wrote effective stored procedures 
- Developed intranet site, provided technical support to Sales Force, and wrote user manuals for various applications

positions.title: Web Programmer
positions.description:
- Reviewed existing application code, add in-line comments, and clean up extraneous code.
- Designed and developed the applications using ASP, JavaScript, HTML, VB Scripts, and CSS with MS SQL Server 2000 as backend.
- Created and/or maintained database tables and/or queries in both Access and SQL 2000.
- Implemented a calendar system in various web applications. 
- Involved extensively with the Development team, and overall project from building to implementation.

positions.title: Technical Support Representative
positions.description:
- Customer Service: Provided support to cable modem customers experiencing technical difficulties using the Internet.
- Problem Solving: Resolved billing questions, answered service-related questions and maintained accurate customer account information.
- Troubleshooting: Demonstrated excellent customer service skills by resolving and redirecting inquiries as necessary. 
- Configuration: Configured DHCP, and TCP/IP for Windows 95/98/ME/2000/NT/XP and Mac OS-8.5 to 10.1.1. Configured Outlook Express for Email Access and provided support with Internet Explorer 5.X/6.X.
- Installation: Uninstall/Reinstall network interface card (NIC) and USB driver

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description:
- Troubleshoot undergraduate students’ programming assignments.
- Interpreted C, C++, and Visual Basic .NET programming languages.
- Debug and resolved compiler errors.
- Evaluated and graded exams, homework, and lab assignments for Web Development and Operating System classes.
